[Sir](../persons.html#1652),
I am moved to say something from my own personal knowledge in defence of rustic reading
I do not care whether this is inserted as a letter, but I should like the substance to appear, as I know it to be fact, and I think it is true of many other Hampshire villages[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: It sounds as if this may have enclosed a letter to the Author, the organ of the [Society of Authors](../others.html#44).
